notes.title: Silent Cleaning v.1.1.3 Update
notes.content:
We’ve cleaned up the following bugs:

Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, opening the front door would make the game unplayable.

Thank you for your bug reports and cooperation!

We hope you continue to enjoy your cleaning adventures ✨

notes.title: Silent Cleaning v1.1.1 Update
notes.content:
Thank you so much for playing “Silent Cleaning”! 🧹✨
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue that could make the game unplayable under certain areas or conditions.
Adjustments
Adjusted background music playback in specific areas.

Disabled certain internal functions.

Updated some in-game images and warning messages.

You can now switch cleaning tools using the mouse wheel scroll.

Thank you for your bug reports and support!
We hope you continue to enjoy your cleaning adventures. ✨
